caption: The drawing depicts three powder horns, with one in the center shown in full detail and two on either side displaying different views of similar objects. All three horns are colored in shades of beige and ivory, with fine line engravings covering the surfaces. The central horn has a dark brown, almost black, carved spout with ringed and geometric detailing; its body is adorned with etched images of sailing ships, a coastline, buildings, and possibly trees or foliage. The two side horns, depicted in a lighter beige color, show similar engraved designs with multiple ships, coastline lines, and hints of landscapes or settlements. The drawing is done on a pale tan background, and the engraved lines are rendered in fine, precise detail. The composition arranges the horns diagonally across the image, providing multiple perspectives of the decorative carvings on their surfaces.
title: Powder Horn
